Missing from the old documentation#

  • Network calculator has no description anywhere except a one-word mention in user-guide §37 (docs/user-guide.md:4724-4726); code: app/static/js/net_calc.js:1-7.
  • Transaction tracer's Correlate attack log button and /txn-trace/correlate (app/views/txn_trace.py:238-258, app/static/js/txn_trace.js:335-364) are not mentioned in user-guide §37.3.
  • Tracer Derive (leg B) UI flow — appliance picker + server-policy field (app/static/js/txn_trace.js:84-95) — not described step by step.
  • Release Notes Discover versions / version-picker scan flow (app/views/release_notes.py:451-484; release_notes_modal.html:132-147) and the Scout advisory switch in Upgrade advisor (release_notes.py:241-284; modal:249-256) are absent from user-guide §31.1.
  • AI Advisor /advisor/usage request ledger is JSON-only (app/views/advisor.py:214-243); no UI page links to it — the docs (ai-advisor.md:181) present it as "readable at /advisor/usage" without saying it is an API.
  • AI Advisor seeds ollama-local with a hard-coded LAN base URL and model (app/services/advisor.py:69, 315-325); docs never tell the admin to check/adjust it. — Fixed (TL-32, decision: seed ollama-local disabled at http://localhost:11434, existing providers unchanged, commit d695601).
  • AI Advisor settings changes (flags, provider save/delete, default) write no audit entry (app/views/settings.py:2943-3001) — not stated anywhere.
  • Python Console prerequisites (bwrap installed, app/services/py_console.py run_python "sandbox unavailable…") and the 1,000-row dataset cap (app/services/dbintrospect.py:196) are undocumented.
  • Lua Studio needs a luac binary even for FortiADC structural lint (app/services/lua_studio.py lint(): luac check precedes the fortiadc branch).
  • Sentinel has no user-level entry in user-guide.md at all (only docs/sentinel-architecture.md, an engineering document).

Stale or wrong in the old documentation#

  • user-guide §31.1 says the Release Notes modal is opened from "the top banner" (docs/user-guide.md:4173); it is in the Tools menu since the support group moved (app/templates/base.html:173-189, 281-282).
  • user-guide §31.1 documents a ⤓ Sync from git button doing git pull (docs/user-guide.md:4188-4191) and a publish option that commits/pushes the corpus (docs/user-guide.md:4196-4198). Code replaced it with Reload corpus (re-read from disk, no git) and ignores publish (app/views/release_notes.py:287-333, 530-534; release_notes_modal.html:100-106).
  • user-guide §31 contains a misplaced subsection "### 30.7 What happens when a new firmware line ships" (docs/user-guide.md:4121) before §31.1.
  • docs/ai-advisor.md:77-79 claims external redaction removes "internal hostnames, RFC1918 addresses, node names". The built-in table only rewrites RFC1918 IPv4 and personal webmail addresses (app/services/doc_publication.py:323-339); hostnames/node names only if a local overlay file (data/publication-rules.local.json) supplies rules.
  • docs/ai-advisor.md:301-302 and user-guide §33.3 (docs/user-guide.md:4315-4317) say the paperclip attaches Lua scripts and SoT search results; the UI menu only offers "Exceptions — " (app/templates/advisor/index.html:452-465). The lua handler (index.html:487-488) has no menu item and /advisor/attach/sot-search (app/views/advisor.py:206-211) is never called. — Fixed (TL-04, commit 7f0f539).
  • user-guide §37.3 "Destinations. Inventory appliances are always available" (docs/user-guide.md:4841) — for leg C the UI always sends mode_c: 'free' (app/static/js/txn_trace.js:161), so a backend can never be an inventory destination and any leg C needs monitoring.probe_free. — Fixed (TL-01, commit fbdc49e).
  • user-guide §23.1 "A published plugin is readable by any signed-in user in that ADOM" (docs/user-guide.md:2097): only the gallery is ADOM-scoped; /plugins/view/<slug> and /plugins/<id>/frame (app/views/plugins.py:172-185, 241-251) load by slug/id with no ADOM check. — Fixed (TL-02/25, commit fb6fc14).
  • user-guide §23.1 "cannot fetch anything back from the app" (docs/user-guide.md:2112) is true for SATOM, but the frame CSP allows img-src https: (app/views/plugins.py:196, 225), so plugin JS can send data to any external HTTPS host via image requests. — Fixed (TL-03, commit fb6fc14).
  • app/views/database.py:255 comment "USER_MANAGE only" — the gate is studio.python_console (database.py:287, 293). — Fixed (TL-05, commit 7f0f539).

Inconsistencies between code, UI and configuration#

  • AI Advisor: earlier turns re-sent unredacted to external providers. User messages are stored raw (app/services/advisor.py:812-815) and the last 20 messages are sent as history (advisor.py:819-823); only the newest message is redacted. The pre-send preview (advisor.py:595-623) shows only the new message, not the history. — Fixed (TL-06, commit 007f332).
  • AI Advisor treats any ollama-kind provider as LAN-local regardless of base URL (app/services/advisor.py:681, 604): no redaction, no "Allow external providers" gate, no export-log row. — Fixed (TL-07, commit 007f332).
  • Lua Studio marks a script "deployed" without pushing. With confirm=yes and no appliance selected, deploy() returns the dry-run plan with no error (app/services/lua_studio.py:239-241) and the view sets status = "deployed" (app/views/lua_studio.py:173-180). — Fixed (TL-08, commit fbdc49e).
  • Transaction tracer correlation passes the destination IPs of the legs as source_ips (app/static/js/txn_trace.js:340-343); the service scores them as "source address matches the tracer's egress address" (app/services/txn_trace.py _why), so the IP factor can only match by accident. — Fixed (TL-09, commit fbdc49e).
  • Tracer inventory leg A dials the appliance's management host on port 443 (the dropdown value is a.host, txn_trace.js:114-115; parse_target default 443) while the label reads "Leg A — VIP (through the appliance)". — Fixed (TL-10, commit fbdc49e).
  • Tracer Derive lists every visible appliance (txn_trace.js:116-118) but always uses FortiWebClient (app/views/txn_trace.py:221-224); a FortiADC choice can only fail. — Fixed (TL-11, commit fbdc49e).
  • net_guard docstring says inventory mode includes "a pool member SATOM read from that appliance's live config" (app/services/net_guard.py:12-14); no caller builds such an inventory — only appliance hosts (cert_inspect.py:86-88, txn_trace.py:46-50). — Fixed (TL-12, commit 7f0f539).
  • Backend without scheme on a non-80 port is traced as HTTPS (net_guard.parse_target scheme rule) while the UI placeholder suggests a bare host:8080. — Fixed (TL-13, commit fbdc49e).
  • Certificate inspector: the service supports a key passphrase and an SNI override (app/views/cert_inspect.py:70-71, 89), but the UI has neither field (app/static/js/cert_inspect.js:58-96), so an encrypted key always ends in "supply its passphrase". — Fixed (TL-14, commit fbdc49e).
  • FP explainer UI never sends wpp or decode (app/static/js/fp_triage.js:81), so the exception explanation runs without a WPP; /fp-triage/decode is unused by the UI. — Fixed (TL-15/16, commit 7f0f539).
  • Regex lab rewrite preview maps $0 to the whole match (\g<0>, app/services/regex_lab.py _to_python_repl) while its own FortiWeb flavor note says "$0 is the first ( … ) group of THAT rule" (regex_lab.py:60). — Fixed (TL-17, commit fbdc49e).
  • Menu gating differs from page gating for Studio tools: Global Studio subgroup is inside the user_manage-only Administrator group (base.html:445-503); FortiWeb/FortiADC "Plugins" group shows Plugin/Lua Studio on is_admin_capable (base.html:1034), while the pages check studio.plugin_studio / studio.lua_studio (plugins.py:42-51, lua_studio.py:32-40). FortiADC Administrator lists Python Console without a studio.python_console check (base.html:386-387). — Fixed (TL-18/19/20, commit 7f0f539).
  • Plugin draft/testing view and live preview use is_admin_capable (plugins.py:179-184, 246) rather than studio.plugin_studio. — Fixed (TL-21, commit fbdc49e).
  • Plugin datasets (and Python Console datasets) bypass visible_appliances — no ADOM or maintenance filtering (app/services/plugin_sandbox.py:33-104); audit_recent exposes audit rows to every viewer of a published view, regardless of audit.view. — Fixed (TL-22/23, TL-24, commit fb6fc14).
  • Plugin edit/status/delete and Lua edit/deploy/delete load by id without ADOM scope (plugins.py:78, 99, 130, 161; lua_studio.py:71, 90, 163, 189); Lua device list is Appliance.query.filter_by(kind=…) without visible_appliances (lua_studio.py:43-45). — Fixed (TL-02/25, TL-26/27, commit fb6fc14).
  • Sentinel /sentinel/data poll returns all open incidents unfiltered (app/views/sentinel.py:171-182) while the console filters by visible appliance names (sentinel.py:142-145); /sentinel/incident/<id> has no visibility check (sentinel.py:314-318). — Fixed (TL-28/29, commit fb6fc14).
  • cert_inspect/txn_trace treat holders of coarse user_manage as having monitoring.probe_free (cert_inspect.py:30-40, txn_trace.py:34-39) — outside the _DERIVE model in app/permissions.py. — Fixed (TL-30: fallback kept by design and documented, commit fbdc49e).
  • Hard-coded lab addresses appear as UI placeholders (AI provider Base URL in settings/_ai.html:51; Firecrawl endpoint in partials/release_notes_modal.html:163) and as the seeded Ollama URL (advisor.py:69). — Fixed (TL-31, commit d695601; TL-32, decision: seed disabled at http://localhost:11434, commit d695601).
  • settings/_ai.html:4 comment refers to permission ai_configure, which does not exist (actual: advisor.configure). — Fixed (TL-33, commit d695601).
  • app/views/database.py:256-282 _PYC_EXAMPLES is dead code (template uses py_examples.all_examples()). — Fixed (TL-34, commit 7f0f539).

Not documented (and why)#

  • Bug reports / "Report a problem": an article with slug bug-reports already exists in the monitoring category (another agent); tools-menu links to it.
  • Sentinel internals (scoring factors, gate order, border corroboration, blocklist feed protocol, data model): the brief asked for the user view; the article points to the in-product /sentinel/docs page, which renders those tables from code.
  • Attack Search's AI hooks (/attack-search/analyze, /ask-field) are only mentioned with a link — they belong to the attack-search article.
  • AI Advisor internal design rationale (text-fence tool protocol, streaming/heartbeat internals, timeout tuning) — engineering detail, summarised only where it affects users (180 s provider timeout, Stop behaviour).

Missing from the old documentation#

  • Users/Profiles: the Change Profile dialog (users/_panel.html:219-244, views/users.py:164-186), clone naming " copy N" (views/profiles.py:134-139), delete blocked while users are assigned (views/profiles.py:157-160), the Effective role column and admin-capable badge (profiles/_panel.html:16,32,44-47), and the fact that system profiles are re-synced from code on every boot (app/init.py:2352-2368).
  • Root CLI account recovery satom execute admin reset-password|unlock and satom get user list (deploy/satom_cli/tree.py:122-124, 308-315; cmd_fix.py:573-655) are not in docs/user-guide.md §1/§26.3.
  • Node TLS activation job (validate/mint → write → nginx -t → reload → verify → rollback) and reload warnings absent from user-guide §26.8 (views/settings.py:2058-2111; services/cert_service.py:396-398, 489-515; settings/index.html:2470-2484, 2648-2651, 2686-2702). CSR generation also absent (settings/index.html:2507-2543; cert_service.py:643-754).
  • Trust store per-slot Save root CA / Save intermediate CA, Content modal, Disable/Enable and two-click Delete absent from user-guide §10.1 (settings/index.html:2854-2873, 2901-2919, 3042-3116; views/settings.py:2251-2295).
  • Certificate Manager Renewals page and on-device certificate detail (swap to SNI/GUI, Remove from device) not described (views/cert_manager.py:173-304, 439-451, 464-570); tls-alpn-01 challenge missing (services/settings_store.py:770).
  • System Backup: code rollback (views/system_backup.py:214-238), device-config version compare (:130-145), appliance-pushed archive browsing (:259-325), firmware pull (:241-254), wider bundle contents (services/system_backup.py:161-210), FERNET_KEY mismatch warning on restore (services/recovery.py:211-232).
  • Software Update: reconciler 60 s tick and 15-minute back-off (app/reconciler_runtime.py:21; services/reconciler.py:48); package preflight disk rule 3×/6× and 400 MB / 5 staged limits (services/update_package_service.py:35, 38, 436-444).
  • HA: load-balancer probe /healthz/primary 200/503 (app/init.py:1211-1226).
  • API tokens: capabilities and AppID scope (app/models_api_token.py:66-147), Edit dialog with expiry rules (views/api_tokens.py:89-129), revoke vs delete (:132-159).
  • Audit log filters and ADOM scoping (views/audit.py:45-98; services/product_scope.py:189-203); audit writes silently dropped on a read-only standby (services/audit.py:183-184).
  • Database tools: 8-second statement timeout, 1,000-row cap, blocked keywords (services/dbintrospect.py:192-196, 260); report limits 20 widgets / 500 rows (services/db_reports.py:23-24).
  • Settings: Vault tab has no section in the old guide, only a table row (user-guide.md:2291 vs settings/index.html:972-1161); peer service actions and library "Also apply on the peer node(s)" (views/settings.py:394-441, 470-528); Authentication "Roster source" selector (settings/index.html:1838-1846) and approval gate default OFF (services/auth_store.py:98); Sentinel settings field list (sentinel/config.py:31-558).

Stale or wrong in the old documentation#

  • user-guide.md:2526-2528 says the profile catalog has "eleven areas"; code has twelve, including AI Advisor (app/permissions.py:19-44).
  • user-guide.md:2522 says Users can "create, edit, disable, reset, assign a profile"; the Users panel offers no edit or reset-password control (users/_panel.html:122-147). The routes exist but nothing in the UI reaches them (views/users.py:126-161, 209-240). — Fixed (AD-61, decision: Reset password and Clear 2FA exposed per row in Users, audited; /users/<id>/edit and /role removed, commit eb22fc7).
  • user-guide.md:97 and the audit chapter promise before/after change history; the AuditLog table has no before/after fields (app/models.py:985-999).
  • user-guide.md:893-896 says both trust-store boxes are submitted as one transaction; the UI sends one slot per Save (settings/index.html:3002-3016). The view comment at views/settings.py:2209-2214 is also stale.
  • user-guide.md:2987-2995 and :4280 describe Node TLS renew-mode controls and an autopull "test now" button; none exist in settings/index.html:2485-2577 (only routes, views/settings.py:2000-2030). — Fixed (AD-62, decision: Node TLS page exposes the renew-mode selector, autopull source fields and Test now, commit 57295dc).
  • user-guide.md:907-908: incomplete-chain check is said to consult public roots; chain_gaps() checks only the store (services/trust_store.py:396-410).
  • encryption-and-node-tls.md:152-153 says the web process runs as root with no privileged-runner hop; code uses a sudo allowlist with a root-runner fallback (services/cert_service.py:319-332, 365-446).
  • acme-certificate-manager.md:7-8 gives the path "Settings → Certificate Manager → ADCS/ACME"; the menu is Settings → Certificates & Trust → Certificate Manager (settings/_nav.html:96-99).
  • user-guide.md:2830 says the System Backup table lists local and off-box bundles; the view passes local-only list_backups() (views/system_backup.py:98).
  • user-guide.md:2183-2184 says the HA arrow shows WAL lag; the labels are fixed text (high_availability/index.html:460-465). — Fixed (AD-64: diagram labels are now mode-aware; lag stays on the node cards, commit fef89ec).
  • git-backup-and-outage.md:45 says reconciler AUTO is the default; code defaults to manual (services/reconciler.py:13-14, 106). git-backup-and-outage.md:93 cites the retired git_bundle automation (services/scheduled_actions.py:296-302).
  • user-guide.md:1700-1701 refers to "Activate"/"Preview" theme buttons; the button is Apply with live preview and Stop preview (settings/index.html:4255).
  • user-guide.md:1691-1693, theming.md:140-142: logos are said to be in system backup bundles; data/branding is not included (services/system_backup.py:142-200). theming.md:136: empty logo falls back to img/satom-mark.png, not per-ADOM marks (base.html:78-84). theming.md:104-108: default accent is now #0A3F9F (services/theme_tokens.py:120).
  • api_v1.md:49 says tokens bind to fortiweb/fortiadc/global only; FortiAuthenticator and FortiAnalyzer ADOMs also have cap_tokens (app/branding.py:89, 101). api_v1.md:307 says every authenticated call is audited; ping, appliances, get_run are not (app/api_v1/routes.py:74-120, 303).
  • user-guide.md:2421-2425 (§26.1): Application name, session lock, poll interval, log levels, log format and raw JSON are presented as live; app_name is read only in auth/profile.html:208,212 and the others are saved (services/settings_store.py:293-306) but read nowhere. — Fixed (AD-63, decision: session lock enforced as idle timeout, log levels/format applied at boot and on save, poll interval and raw-JSON fields removed; app_name unchanged, commit b38f3da).
  • user-guide.md:2488 says a peer is never touched from Services; peer actions exist (views/settings.py:410-441).
  • user-guide.md:2870, 2873 say seven alert families; there are eight (services/alert_routing.py:81-82).
  • user-guide.md:3115 says every other ADOM is deletable; ADOMs that still own appliances are not (views/settings.py:1004-1062, 1205-1218).
  • user-guide.md:4299-4300 says ollama-local is seeded when Settings is opened; it is seeded by /advisor (views/advisor.py:41, 53).
  • user-guide.md:1442, 1451: "three blocks per scope" holds only for product scopes (services/thresholds.py:691-710).

Inconsistencies between code, UI and configuration#

  • Profiles tab vs profile routes: the Settings → Profiles tab is rendered for anyone with user_manage (settings/index.html:963-968; views/settings.py:82-83), but every /profiles/ route requires profiles.manage (views/profiles.py:22, 44-174). A custom profile with users.manage only sees the table and gets 403 on every button. — Fixed (AD-01, commit fef89ec).
  • users.view is an orphan permission: it is in the catalog (app/permissions.py:105) but no route, template or _DERIVE entry uses it. — Fixed (AD-02, decision: /users/ opens read-only to users.view, actions stay users.manage, commit eb22fc7).
  • Password minimums disagree: Add User says "Min. 8 characters" (users/_panel.html:188), but create and admin reset enforce no minimum (views/users.py:89-91, 216-218); self-service change enforces 8 (app/auth/routes.py:299); the CLI enforces 12 (deploy/satom_cli/cmd_fix.py:619). Settings → Change Password only checks non-empty (views/settings.py:1237-1247). — Partly fixed (GS-02/AD-03/AD-04/AD-05: one 8-character minimum on every web password path — Add User, admin reset, Settings → Change Password, reset link; the CLI keeps 12, commit 4053cb7). — Fixed (AD-06, decision: one 12–1024-character length-only policy for web, CLI and installers, commit 1813453).
  • Duplicate audit entries: changing a profile writes user.profile.set twice (views/users.py:64 via _commit_unless_orphans_admins, then :183-184); the legacy role route does the same with user.role.set (:280-283). — Fixed (AD-07, AD-08, commit eb22fc7).
  • "Admins" counter ≠ anti-lockout definition: the counter counts legacy role admin (= holds users.manage) (users/_panel.html:20), while anti-lockout counts users holding users.manage AND profiles.manage (app/permissions.py:216; services/access.py:13-21). — Fixed (AD-09, commit eb22fc7).
  • Help text points to a non-existent menu: "Manage profiles under Admin → Profiles" (users/_panel.html:204); the menu is Settings → Access & Identity → Profiles (settings/_nav.html:92). — Fixed (AD-10, commit eb22fc7).
  • POST /users/<id>/edit renames without a uniqueness check (views/users.py:142); a clash would raise a database error (unique column, app/models.py:56). No UI reaches the route. — Fixed (AD-11: route removed, commit eb22fc7).
  • No way to unlock an account in the web UI: lockout is 10 failures / 15 minutes (app/auth/routes.py:30-31, 139-142); only the root CLI clears it. satom execute admin unlock is described as "Clear a lockout without touching the password" (deploy/satom_cli/tree.py:313) but also sets is_active = True (cmd_fix.py:589), so it re-enables disabled and pending-approval accounts; CLI account writes are not audited. — Partly fixed (AD-14: CLI admin reset-password / admin unlock now write an audit row as cli/root; unlock still re-activates disabled accounts, commit 1992e12). — Fixed (AD-12, decision: audited Unlock action in Users that clears only the lockout, commit eb22fc7; AD-13: CLI unlock no longer re-enables the account, commit 1813453).
  • Audit log has no permission gate: /audit/ is @login_required only (views/audit.py:30-32) while its link is gated on user_manage (base.html:369); audit.view gates nothing. The Export CSV button links back to the page itself (audit/index.html:23-26); paging controls check variables the view never passes (audit/index.html:181 vs views/audit.py:109-119); "To Date" excludes that day (views/audit.py:92-96). — Partly fixed (AD-15: /audit/ now requires audit.view and its menu entry shows only to holders; Export CSV, paging and To Date unchanged, commit a66b23f). — Fixed (AD-16, AD-17, AD-18: Export CSV downloads the filtered entries, paging renders, To Date is inclusive, commit 1d2c22f).
  • Operators can save Sentinel and Scout settings: saves need config_write (views/settings.py:3291, 3354), held by the operator profile, while the panes are admin-only; GET /settings/sentinel and the demos only require login (:3405-3434). — Partly fixed (AD-20: GET /settings/sentinel and the demos now require view; saves still need only config_write, commit a66b23f). — Fixed (AD-19, decision: Sentinel and Scout saves require user_manage, commit 4742a0a).
  • Hour thresholds silently fall back to defaults: the Thresholds tab saves SATOM-scope hours as floats (services/thresholds.py:441, 627) and the alert engine parses them with int() (services/alerts.py:117-121, 399, 558, 695). — Fixed (AD-21, commit 3176218).
  • "Enable email sending" does not stop all email (settings/index.html:1180 vs services/alerts.py:1150-1153, views/reports.py:46, 72, services/cert_manager.py:1203, 1221, services/email_service.py:296-307). — Fixed (AD-22, commit 3176218).
  • ADOM delete has no confirmation: the inline onsubmit confirm (settings/index.html:4142) is blocked by CSP script-src-attr 'none' (app/init.py:1152). — Fixed (AD-23, commit 3176218).
  • New LDAP bind password ignored when a vault is active: save writes only the local copy (services/auth_store.py:431-433), sign-in reads the vault copy first (:301-302). LDAP/RADIUS timeouts are reset to 8 s on each save (:423, 440); the Default profile placeholder says "operator" but the default is readonly (settings/index.html:1747; auth_store.py:84). — Fixed (AD-24, AD-25, commit 3176218; AD-26, commit fef89ec).
  • Certificate Manager: ACME issuance still requires an ADCS class template (views/cert_manager.py:509-513) though cert_manager_configured() does not (services/settings_store.py:979-990); UI says ADCS / "Target FortiWeb" / "over SSH" regardless of protocol and target (cert_manager/index.html:37, 96, 103; new.html:19, 26, 36, 63); ca_request_id is never set (app/models.py:1890) and status expiring is never assigned (:1878). The menu entry is visible to every user who then gets 403 (base.html:425-426). — Fixed (AD-27, commit 3176218; AD-28, AD-29, AD-30, AD-31, commit fef89ec).
  • Node TLS: footnote "never replicated" (settings/index.html:2501) contradicts nightly peer install of imported certs (app/init.py:1315-1320; services/cert_service.py:1178-1311); Renew now on an imported cert shows the nginx-reload warning though nothing is reloaded (cert_service.py:832-837). — Fixed (AD-32, AD-33, commit 57295dc).
  • Trust store wording: "Tick 'Verify TLS'" (services/trust_store.py:495-496) vs the appliance form label "Verify SSL Certificate" (appliances/edit.html:34). — Fixed (AD-34, commit fef89ec).
  • Code rollback skips the staged-rollout safeguard that Apply enforces (views/system_backup.py:235 vs views/self_update.py:109-113) and does not catch the container-runtime refusal (views/self_update.py:126). Offline package apply has no container-runtime check either (services/update_package_service.py:479-516 vs services/self_update.py:335-340). — Fixed (AD-35, AD-36, AD-37, commit 234dc17).
  • No audit logging for system backup create/restore/delete, git updates, code rollback, HA mode, node registry or promotion (views/system_backup.py, views/ha.py, views/self_update.py — only package/API-pack routes call log_action). Manual "Create backup now" never pushes off-box (views/system_backup.py:154). — Partly fixed (AD-38..42: audit rows for system backup create/restore/delete, git bundle create/settings/delete, firmware pull, code rollback, git update apply, deploy-automation mode, HA mode, promotion and node registry; manual backup still not pushed off-box, commit 1992e12). — Fixed (AD-43: Create backup now can push to the backup server, commit 234dc17).
  • Stale tab name "Settings → SoT & Backup" in system_backup/index.html:697 and services/backup_server.py:37; the tab no longer exists. — Fixed (AD-44, commit fef89ec).
  • Templates ship deployment-specific placeholders/defaults (internal names, addresses, schedule IDs): system_backup/index.html:30, 38, 51, 80, 506, 510; high_availability/index.html:103, 230, 234; settings/index.html:801, 3948; settings/_ai.html:51; views/advisor.py:69; sentinel/config.py:220; services/settings_store.py:1459; services/thresholds.py:153. Not reproduced in the articles. — Fixed (AD-45, commit fef89ec; AD-46, decision: Sentinel AI endpoint ships empty and AI stays off until set, seeded backup schedule name without host, commit 4742a0a).
  • API tokens: the admin scope is only checked in app/api_v1/waf.py:139, 165 and minting does not check the owner's permissions (views/api_tokens.py:70); the edit modal hint "all unchecked = no restriction" contradicts explicit-only write capabilities (api_tokens/index.html:236 vs :100); the sidebar link appears only in the FortiWeb ADOM (base.html:1019); Revoke/Delete have no confirmation (api_tokens/index.html:166-174). — Partly fixed (AD-47/48: admin scope honoured only when the owner holds user_manage, and minting/editing refuses scopes the owner cannot use; edit hint, sidebar placement and missing confirmations unchanged, commit 4053cb7). — Fixed (AD-49, AD-50, AD-51, commit fef89ec).
  • Appearance: importing the same theme a third time hits the unique-name constraint and errors (views/settings.py:2675-2676; app/models_theme.py:35); logo/favicon pickers accept fewer types than the server (settings/index.html:4325, 4333 vs views/settings.py:2363). — Fixed (AD-52, commit 3176218; AD-53, commit fef89ec).
  • Database tools: Edit is offered on built-in reports, whose save then fails (database/report_view.html:13); CSV export before Run yields error,empty query (database/index.html:89, 204); sensitive-column masking is bypassed by an alias (services/dbintrospect.py:266). — Fixed (AD-54, AD-55, commit 3176218; AD-56, decision: queries referencing a credential table are refused before execution and audited, masking kept, commit f81fe91).
  • DNS Lookup save redirects without the tab hash, landing on General (views/settings.py:1765, 1768); /settings/naming and /settings/segments redirect to tabs that no longer exist (:890-931). — Fixed (AD-57, AD-58, commit fef89ec).
  • FAZ Menu: re-enabling a group does not restore its items (settings/index.html:4679-4685). Security Status card is hard-coded (:4777-4786). — Fixed (AD-59, commit 3176218; AD-60, commit fef89ec).

Not documented (and why)#

  • Users routes without a UI control (/users/<id>/edit, /reset-password, /clear-2fa, /role): listed only under Advanced in users-and-profiles, not as procedures, because no screen reaches them. — Fixed (AD-61, decision: Reset password and Clear 2FA now in the Users UI; /edit and /role removed, commit eb22fc7).
  • Directory sign-in, import and approval mechanics: documented in settings-authentication; users-and-profiles only links to it.
  • Own password / 2FA / recovery email: settings-my-account.
  • Server Objects certificate import and clone carry (services/cert_import.py, cert_carry.py): belong to server-objects / policy-cloning.
  • Inter-node identity key, pg_hba/replication mTLS internals, CA custody report: technical/HA internals with no UI.
  • services/ha.py and ha_inventory.py: appliance (FortiWeb/FortiADC) HA, not SATOM's own pair — belongs to appliances.
  • Offline package building/signing: left to offline-updates. Detailed /api/v1 reference: left to api.
  • Python console: excluded from database-tools by assignment (python-console).
  • Theme token generator workflow (deploy/gen_theme_tokens.py): developer-only.
  • Shipped defaults containing internal addresses/names: described without their values.
  • /settings/peer/* node-to-node endpoints and /hypervisors/<id>/inventory: internal, mentioned only in Advanced notes.

Missing from the old documentation#

  • docs/cli.md §8 (docs/cli.md:688) documents only flask apilib evidence and baseline commands; the flask apilib pack export|inspect|import group exists at app/cli_apilib.py:290-351. The other app-level Flask commands (create-db, cert-renew, cert-autopull, alerts-run, preflight, postflight, canary-restore — app/__init__.py:1270-1514) are not listed in any operator doc.
  • No document lists the environment variables the code reads (SATOM_DEVICE_JOBS, SATOM_JOB_INLINE_S app/services/device_jobs.py:123,144, SATOM_DEVICE_LOCK_MAX_WAIT_S app/services/job_progress.py:44, CACHE_REDIS_URI app/services/cache.py:39, SATOM_METRICS_URL app/services/vm_store.py:66, MAX_UPLOAD_MB app/config.py:67, FORTINET_HOST_CONCURRENCY app/clients/base.py:23, the *_DIR overrides, SATOM_ADMIN_PASSWORD_FILE app/__init__.py:2426). Now in configuration-files.
  • The internal /api/fw/<id>/proxy/<path> and /api/adc/<id>/proxy/<path> pass-through (app/api/proxy.py:33,65) is undocumented.
  • Device actions running as background jobs with a 2 s inline window and per-device queueing (app/services/device_jobs.py:1-38) is not described in the user guide or engineering manual; added to architecture.
  • Error reference IDs on the 500 page and their log location data/logs/satom.log (app/errors.py:1-14,190) are only in code comments; added to error-messages/troubleshooting.
  • The full status vocabularies (job pausing/paused app/services/jobs.py:60-62, process run/verdict/step values app/models_process.py:55-74, CR transitions app/services/change_requests.py:43-160,553-575) have no single reference; added in statuses.

Stale or wrong in the old documentation#

  • docs/engineering.md:72 and CLAUDE.md:40 say gunicorn runs "4 workers × 8 gthread threads"; deploy/satom.service ExecStart passes only --workers 4 --timeout 600 (no --threads/--worker-class), i.e. sync workers.
  • docs/engineering.md:72 says gunicorn binds 0.0.0.0:8000 behind an edge nginx; the installer rewrites it to 127.0.0.1:8000 (installers/install-satom.sh:1690).
  • docs/engineering.md:44 (and CLAUDE.md §3) describe the registry as "DB-first + YAML fallback"; the YAML seeds are gone — the fallback is the sealed JSON baseline (app/registry/loader.py:1-20, app/__init__.py:2915-2923).
  • docs/engineering.md:38,40,301 count "~60 blueprints" / "~80 modules"; _register_blueprints lists ~95 (app/__init__.py:2214-2304) and app/services/ has 242 modules.
  • docs/engineering.md:161 "Three products share one app"; the product gate handles five ADOM keys incl. fortianalyzer and fortiauthenticator (app/__init__.py:300-305, app/branding.py:41-101).
  • docs/engineering.md:168 gives the ADOM order as URL > X-ADOM > _adom form > session; code lets a ?_adom= query parameter override the header (app/__init__.py:278-283).
  • docs/engineering.md:124-125 says satom-ha-datasync authenticates to the primary as root; it runs as the service account and logs in as the service account with a forced read-only command (deploy/satom-ha-datasync.sh:13-20, installers/install-satom.sh:1653-1657).
  • docs/engineering.md:79 "Nightly pg_dump via cron" — the installer creates no cron entry; nightly dumps come from the system_backup scheduled action (deploy/satom_cli/cmd_fix.py:43-44).
  • docs/engineering.md:81 presents Redis as part of the runtime; the host installer neither installs Redis nor sets RATELIMIT_STORAGE_URI (installers/install-satom.sh:257-262,1395-1403), so host installs use per-worker memory:// (app/config.py:64). The comment at app/config.py:61-62 ("Production sets redis:// in .env") is likewise untrue for installer-built nodes.
  • docs/safeguards.md:659 says the CSP nonce is "Per-request"; it is stable per session on purpose (app/__init__.py:947-963).
  • docs/safeguards.md:663 lists "/api/v1 30/min"; only four write endpoints are limited to 30/min and firmware-check to 10/min (app/api_v1/routes.py:126,222, waf.py:174,304, adc.py:156); read endpoints have no limit.
  • docs/safeguards.md:4036 references satom get monitor coverage, which does not exist (deploy/satom_cli/tree.py; the command is get monitor status).
  • docs/privilege-model.md:29 still lists git-publish among service-account units; the unit was retired (installers/install-satom.sh:1782).
  • docs/api_v1.md:6 names an internal management host as Base URL; docs/api_v1.md:49 says tokens bind to fortiweb, fortiadc or global, but tokens may bind to every active ADOM incl. FortiAnalyzer/FortiAuthenticator (app/models_api_token.py:31-33, app/branding.py:47-101 all cap_tokens: True).
  • docs/api_v1.md:287-300 error table omits unknown_action (400), server_error (500), probe_failed/firmware-check 502 and unknown_capability (app/api_v1/routes.py:145,234,340, app/models_api_token.py:264).
  • docs/INSTALL.md:837 recommends a git_bundle scheduled action at 03:15; satom execute seed actions does not create it (deploy/satom_cli/cmd_fix.py:38-81) and docs/metrics-architecture.md §6 says new installs do not seed it.
  • docs/INSTALL.md:824 points to "Settings → Alerts"; the tab is labelled "Email & Alerts" (app/templates/settings/_nav.html:116).
  • docs/INSTALL.md:862 uninstall removes only sites-enabled|sites-available/satom.conf; on RHEL/Arch the installer writes /etc/nginx/conf.d/satom.conf and on SUSE /etc/nginx/vhosts.d/satom.conf (installers/install-satom.sh:1843-1851).
  • docs/offline-update-packages.md:26 says "Settings -> Software Update"; Software Update is its own page at /self-update (app/views/self_update.py:22), not a Settings tab. installers/install-satom.sh:236 similarly says "Software Update → HA nodes"; the HA node registry is on the High Availability page (app/templates/high_availability/index.html:184). — Partly fixed (TR-21: the installer hint now points to High Availability → Add node, commit ae2a8c2).
  • deploy/nginx-vhost.conf:42 sample sets client_max_body_size 50M, while uploads up to 400 MB are accepted and the installer-written vhost uses 400M (deploy/tls-bootstrap.sh:230, app/services/update_package_service.py:35). — Fixed (TR-22, commit 4e6b062).

Inconsistencies between code, UI and configuration#

  • Unit templates vs installed reality: deploy/satom.service, satom-scheduler.service, satom-reconciler.service declare User=root and --bind 0.0.0.0:8000; correctness depends entirely on installer sed + drop-ins (installers/install-satom.sh:1653-1703). deploy/install.sh:49-54 still copies the root/0.0.0.0 unit unchanged and writes a SQLite SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI (deploy/install.sh:35) — a legacy installer that contradicts the privilege model. — Partly fixed (TR-01: the shipped satom.service now binds 127.0.0.1:8000; User=root in the templates and the legacy deploy/install.sh are unchanged, commit 4053cb7). — Fixed (TR-03, decision: legacy deploy/install.sh deleted, commit e5ed5fe).
  • satom_enforce_unit_user writes User= drop-ins for satom/scheduler/reconciler/alerts/cert-renew/metrics/ha-datasync only (installers/install-satom.sh:1655-1657). satom-responder.service is rewritten by sed (:1693-1703) but gets no drop-in, so the next update re-copies User=satom; satom-integrations.service gets neither. With a custom SATOM_APP_USER these units run under a different account from the rest. — Fixed (TR-05, commit ae2a8c2).
  • registry.view ("Browse the endpoint registry & API explorer", app/permissions.py:84) is never checked: the Explorer index and GET execution only require login (app/views/api_explorer.py:213-215,411-413). — Fixed (TR-06 / PR-03, commit a66b23f).
  • /api/fw/<id>/proxy/<path> allows any signed-in user to issue arbitrary GETs to an appliance with no permission beyond login, while the API Explorer applies the API-library build guard; the proxy has no such guard (app/api/proxy.py:33-62). — Partly fixed (TR-07: the relay now requires registry.view, commit a66b23f).
  • registry.toggle flips a row by id without checking row.product == 'fortiweb' (app/views/registry.py:127-142), while save enforces it (app/views/registry.py:100-106) — cross-ADOM soft-delete is possible from the FortiWeb page. — Fixed (TR-09, commit fb6fc14).
  • Scheduled action last_status = "missed" (app/scheduler_runtime.py:75) has no badge in app/templates/scheduled_actions/index.html:160-170 (renders "—"), and the template's running branch is unreachable because last_status is only ever set to the final run status (app/services/scheduled_actions.py:1896). — Fixed (TR-10 / TR-11, commit 4e6b062).
  • change_requests.approve() and cancel() have no status guard (app/services/change_requests.py:112,143); a POST can approve or cancel a completed/failed CR (the views check only user_manage and ADOM scope, app/views/change_requests.py:1150-1191). — Fixed (TR-12 / TR-13, commit ae2a8c2).
  • satom show sudoers says the rule grants "Everything under 'execute' and 'config'" (deploy/satom_cli/cmd_show.py:106); there is no config command group. — Fixed (TR-14, commit 4e6b062).
  • app/services/hook_runner.py:4,499 and integration_hooks.py:24 say the queue is data/integration-requests/; code and the .path unit use data/integrations/queue (app/services/integration_hooks.py:50, deploy/satom-integrations.path). — Fixed (TR-15, commit 4e6b062).
  • app/services/pg_ssl.py:8 says "the web process is root on this node" — contradicts the privilege model. — Fixed (TR-16, commit ae2a8c2).
  • deploy/nginx-vhost.conf:8-9 comment says the installer configures gunicorn on 127.0.0.1:8000, while the shipped unit binds 0.0.0.0:8000 (only rewritten by install-satom.sh). — Fixed (TR-01, commit 4053cb7).
  • Admin-password minimums differ by path: install-satom.sh ≥ 8 characters (installers/install-satom.sh:813), satom-setup.sh ≥ 10 characters and three classes (installers/satom-setup.sh:203-205), password reset/change ≥ 8 (app/auth/routes.py:271,299). — Partly fixed (GS-02 / AD-03 / AD-04 / AD-05: one 8-character minimum on every web password path; the installer scripts are unchanged, commit 4053cb7). — Fixed (TR-18, decision: one 12–1024 character length-only rule in the web console, CLI and both installers, commit 1813453).
  • docs/INSTALL.md §2.3 says the container shape renounces "five capabilities" then "the four come back"; §2 says "four host-only web actions". — Fixed (TR-19, commit 4e6b062).
  • Local failed sign-ins (not locked yet) write no audit row; only lockouts, locked attempts and directory failures do (app/auth/routes.py:109,134,146 vs :148). — Fixed (TR-20, commit 1992e12).

Not documented (and why)#

  • Discovery-run routes /web/api-explorer/discovery/plan|run|register — the code states they are unreachable from any page (app/views/_discovery.py:20-28).
  • /_updiag, /sw.js, /upload-worker.js and the admin self-test error routes (app/__init__.py:162-224, app/errors.py:225-270) — internal/diagnostic.
  • Container operations agent internals (deploy/docker/satom_agent.py) — covered by the container-ops article of another writer; installation only summarises.
  • Release pipeline / public-mirror mechanics (docs/release-pipeline.md, deploy/gen_*) — vendor build process, not operator-facing.
  • Per-module service internals from docs/safeguards.md (593 sections) — only verified highlights were used in security-model.
  • Exact list of the ~230 job-wrapped device routes (app/services/device_jobs.py DEVICE_BLUEPRINTS) — too volatile; described as a mechanism.

SATOM 3.0 — knowledge lanes, pack trust, FortiGate ADOM#

Inventory#

Module / screen URL Key actions Permission Article
Software Update → Knowledge packs /self-update/#knowledge-packs Check now, Download, Import, fetch mode, feed URL users.manage knowledge-packs
Pack trust (console) — satom show trust, trust add-key/remove-key --purpose root pack-trust
Administrator → Signatures → freshness card /signatures/#sig-freshness read-only status per FortiWeb users.manage signature-freshness
FortiGate ADOM /fgt/, /fgt/m/ select device, read sections any view permission fortigate
Release Notes window (packs only) modal Reload corpus, Knowledge packs… view / users.manage release-notes
Upgrading to 3.0 — seed actions, verify, rollback users.manage upgrading-to-3-0

Missing from the old documentation#

  • FortiGate ADOM was not in docs/user-guide.md §3 (the ADOM-table guard was red on the integration branch); fixed in the repo docs.
  • The two 3.0 scheduled actions (knowledge_fetch, signature_check) are only created by satom execute seed actions; nothing told an upgrading operator (deploy/satom_cli/cmd_fix.py SEED_PLAN).

Stale or wrong in the old documentation#

  • Release notes described a docs.fortinet.com scan that 3.0 removed (tools/release-notes, technical/knowledge-harvester, docs/release_notes.md).
  • "Packs are checked against the same trust store as update packages" — false for 3.0 packs (app/services/api_pack.py _verify).
  • "Each release ships the current knowledge pack in api-packs/" — no longer true from 3.0.0.

Inconsistencies between code, UI and configuration#

  • Software Update, API library packs card (app/templates/self_update/index.html, the "Local data always wins" note) says a copy is replaced by "an API pack over a knowledge pack, a newer pack over an older one of the same lane"; the code (api_pack.outranks) lets the newer snapshot win whatever its lane, using the lane rank only when snapshot times are unknown or equal.
  • alerts.signature_max_days has no field on the Settings pages.
  • The Migration report lists FortiGate as a supported product, but the FortiGate ADOM gate does not admit the migration_report blueprint and no FortiGate backup is stored, so it cannot assess a FortiGate yet.

Not documented (and why)#

  • How the SATOM team operates the harvester and publishes packs: maintainer operations, not product documentation.

SATOM — triage of the Documentation Center audit (2026-10-03)#

Source: audit/01-…09-*.md (inconsistency sections, plus stale rows that live in the app). Verified against /opt/satom HEAD 3488627 (v2.10.1, identical to snap/) by 9 triage agents (one per file, read-only, every S/F row quotes the proving line), then re-checked by the coordinator while fixing. Compound bullets were split, so there are 327 rows for the ~181 audit bullets.

Counts#

class rows meaning
S 51 security / access control / leak / scope bypass / missing audit trail
F 100 functional bug
T 121 text / UI only
D 49 needs an owner decision (rows starting [security] are security findings whose fix changes what a seeded profile can do)
X 6 false positive / already fixed

Phase 1: 51 of 51 S rows fixed, plus F rows AD-03/AD-04/AD-05 (same password helper as GS-02). Commits: 007f332 advisor · a66b23f permission gates · fb6fc14 ADOM/visibility scope · 1992e12 audit trail · 4053cb7 unit bind, passwords, token scopes. Mutations 77/77.

Phases 2–4 (F, T, D — 2026-10-03): 265 of 267 open rows fixed, 2 partly (AU-17: the scheduled upgrade executor is still a stub, documented as such — wiring a real flash needs hardware; FW-07: the Attack ID drawer's proposal actions stay visible to read-only users, the server still refuses them). Every D row was implemented as the owner decision recorded in the fixer brief. Eight area fixers worked on separate branches; the 44 commits were integrated linearly onto main (ae2a8c2…1f67858), then the coordinator fixed what integration and production smokes found (Extra findings below). Mutations: AD 74 · AU 57 · DV 39 · FW 43 · GS/TR 18 · MO 29 · PR 31 · TL 27 · integration 9 — 327/327 bite. The "fixed in" column carries the commit on main.

Released in SATOM 2.11.0 (2026-10-03, cut 88f2440, release run 64: GitHub, update feed, product site, catalog).

Reclassified by the coordinator: GS-01 and AD-56 S→D (reasons in their rows). TL-29b stays open by decision.
